name: compliancecow-insights
description: Real-time compliance dashboards, asset inventory, and control framework visibility for ComplianceCow.
long_description:
ComplianceCow Insights provides real-time visibility into your compliance posture through interactive dashboards, asset inventories, and control framework analytics. Monitor control status, track compliance percentages, identify overdue and non-compliant controls, and explore your cloud infrastructure assets with deep drill-down capabilities.

Key capabilities:
- Common Control Framework (CCF) dashboards with period-based filtering
- Control status tracking: Completed, In Progress, Overdue, Pending
- Framework-level compliance summaries and control details
- Cloud asset inventory with resource type breakdowns
- Compliance checks per resource with pass/fail analysis
- Neo4j graph database queries for compliance evidence exploration
